notes.title: Mac
notes.text: macOS 12+, Apple Silicon (M1 ke atas). Mac Intel belum didukung.

notes.title: Android
notes.text: Android 7+, 64-bit. Untuk kamera: USB OTG, kabel maks. 1 m.

notes.title: Penyimpanan
notes.text: ±1 GB untuk app. Hasil foto hanya ±2% dari aslinya.

notes.title: Kamera USB
notes.text: Kabel data, Wi-Fi kamera dimatikan. Sering putus? Colok ulang kabel dengan mantap.

items: Petunjuk kamera lebih tepat: muncul hanya saat sambungan benar-benar bermasalah.
Perpanjang update langsung di web: kunci terisi otomatis, sekali bayar untuk 2 perangkat.
Beli online: buka halaman beli, bayar QRIS, tempel kunci. Selesai.
App macet atau tertutup? Kirim laporan dengan satu tombol (atas izinmu) supaya cepat kami perbaiki.

notes.title: Mac
notes.text: macOS 12+, Apple Silicon (M1 or newer). Intel Macs not supported yet.

notes.title: Android
notes.text: Android 7+, 64-bit. For the camera: USB OTG, cable up to 1 m.

notes.title: Storage
notes.text: About 1 GB for the app. Results are only about 2% of the originals.

notes.title: USB camera
notes.text: Data cable, camera Wi-Fi off. Keeps dropping? Re-plug the cable firmly.

items: Smarter camera tips: they only appear when the connection really has a problem.
Renew updates right on the web: key filled in, one payment for 2 devices.
Help is just an email away.
Buy online: open the buy page, pay by QRIS, paste the key. Done.
App froze or closed? Send a report with one tap (with your OK) so we can fix it fast.
